skill.label: B — with describe-well skill
skill.text:
Three people building in public, mid-brainstorm, getting kicked out of rooms. One drives the technical architecture (agents, sliders, formalization), one connects everything to applications (copywriting, job apps, advertising), one keeps asking 'but what does it look like for the user?' - quiz systems, synonym selectors, live-updating interfaces.

The vibe is high-trust intellectual riffing with zero hierarchy. Ideas get picked up, extended, and mutated fast. Nobody's filtering for feasibility yet - they're mapping the possibility space. Frequent interruptions are signs of excitement, not rudeness. The conversation has the specific energy of people who met recently but think compatibly - building shared vocabulary in real time.
